headline: Portland sweep the conference and keep on winning
dek: Portland took every point on offer in conference play and have not stopped winning since: fourteen wins overall against two draws and three defeats, every defeat in the season's first month. Miguel-Angel Hernandez has kept seven shutouts behind them.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals sort the top of the table and little else: Seattle U have scored as many as San Francisco and finished below them, and LMU, with the fewest, are not bottom.

wire.line: San Diego's only conference defeat came against Portland, who then beat them again.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eight matches dated before any WCC side had a published result still carry none, and they belong to San Diego, Santa Clara, Saint Mary's College of California and LMU alone.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Saint Mary's College of California have conceded 48 goals, more than any other WCC programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: LMU have scored ten goals and conceded twenty, and both totals are the lowest in the WCC.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: David Raphael has scored ten goals for San Francisco from 61 shots.

last_match.line: San Diego lost by a single goal, as they had at Portland in their previous match.

next_match.line: Portland have won every match since a goalless draw with Oregon State in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
